title: Simple Crosshair
description: Simplifies the crosshair and attack indicator, making them less distracting.
body:
The pack changes the texture of the crosshair and the attack indicator, to make them less distracting. Can be used over other packs.
The following screenshots also use other resource packs (only the crosshair and the attack indicator are included in this resource pack).

---
![An image of the crosshair.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VCEByCBo/images/16074a606915b4c232adf6dabdf660c7102efe99.png)

![An image of the crosshair and the attack indicator.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VCEByCBo/images/a7ea3ad9fc0af369e470654323ff3f7c83bfbf9c.png)
Other resorce packs used in the screenshots: [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones), [Bare Bones Fast Grass](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-fast-grass).
